title: Double-entry ledger & payments API
tagline: An append-only, double-entry ledger with idempotent payments, authorization holds and automated bank reconciliation.

metrics.label: p99 transfer latency
metrics.note: single writer, fsync on every commit (synchronous=FULL)

metrics.label: unexplained recon difference
metrics.note: every cent of bank vs ledger difference attributed to a break

highlights: Append-only journal enforced by SQLite triggers; corrections are reversing entries
Idempotency keys stored in the same transaction as the effect: exactly-once under retries
Authorization holds: available vs pending balance, overdraft rule checked atomically
Hypothesis state machine: random operation sequences never unbalance the books
Reconciliation classifies missing, duplicate, amount and timing breaks against a bank file
limitations: SQLite has one writer: throughput is flat with concurrency; Postgres row locks would scale
Bank statement is synthetic; its generator and the matcher were written together
Single-currency transfers; FX is only possible as hand-built multi-leg entries
